grantSeq.description: The grant this ball end answers. Must match the current grant or the host rejects it.

finalScore.description: The player's score after end-of-ball bonus (see SPEC: sample at the next boundary, not at the drain).

detectorReason.description: Which signal produced the ball end: ROM NVRAM map, table script hook, display text, physical heuristic, a human click, or the host timeout.

shootAgain.description: True when the detector saw an extra ball: the host re-grants the same player and ball.

description: client -> host. Accepted only from the current grant holder.
